name: Why do kitchen door frames experience more wear and damage than other interior doors?

mainEntity.name: Why do kitchen door frames experience more wear and damage than other interior doors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen door frames degrade faster than standard bedroom frames due to high humidity, grease, and heavy everyday traffic. Steam from stovetops, heat from dishwashers, and water splatters from sinks can penetrate unsealed wood joints, causing swelling and rot near the baseboards. Furthermore, kitchen pantry doors and patio doors experience frequent opening and slamming, which loosens hinge screws in the soft jamb wood over time. Kitchen frames also face frequent impacts from grocery bags, trash bins, and moving chairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen frames face elevated moisture from cooking, steam, and sinks, along with heavy physical wear from pantry use, appliance proximity, and frequent foot traffic.
